svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-abu-coat","name":"ABU coat (long sleeve) with blank name tape","size_in":{"w":39.3,"h":38.86},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,3930,3886],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"Outline traced from images/base/ABU_male.webp (581x719 px) at 0.0474 in/px, chosen so the coat is 29.96 in long. No real garment was measured. Body basis only: MIL-DTL-44048H (BDU-style combat coat) gives the same body (Medium Regular half chest 24-1/4 in, back length about 29-3/8 to 29-1/2 in, Large about 30 in), so the 29.96 in length is consistent with a Large Regular; that spec has no pocket sizes in its text, so pocket, tape and button sizes remain estimates. Sleeve cap/width widened by script (same as the OCP coat). Print cell: 1/16 in, from the weave pitch of the cloth (abu-weave-measure.json) and the autocorrelation of the Vanguard coat front (abu-scale-check.json), not from the tape or the pocket size (the pockets and tape are estimates).","anchors":{"top_center":[1965,0],"bottom_center":[1965,3886],"center":[1965,1943],"left_edge":[0,1943],"right_edge":[3930,1943],"seam_top_center_right":[350,920],"seam_top_center_left":[3580,920],"collar_apex":[1965,1340],"hem_center":[1965,3846],"name_tape_top_center":[1580,1605],"cap_tape_top_center":[2350,1605],"chest_pocket_right_center":[1580,2020],"chest_pocket_left_center":[2350,2020],"chest_flap_left_bottom_center":[2350,1930],"chest_flap_right_bottom_center":[1580,1930]},"collar_slots":{"left":{"cadet_officer":{"center":[2314,1101.5],"angle_deg":0,"size_in":{"along":1.75,"across":1.5},"bbox":{"x":2226.5,"y":1026.5,"w":175,"h":150}},"cadet_nco":{"center":[2291.8,1092.5],"angle_deg":0,"size_in":{"along":1.75,"across":1.1},"bbox":{"x":2236.8,"y":1005,"w":110,"h":175}},"officer":{"center":[2269.9,1137],"angle_deg":0,"size_in":{"along":1.3,"across":1.6},"bbox":{"x":2189.9,"y":1072,"w":160,"h":130}},"front_edge":{"p1":[2221,807],"p2":[1965,1340],"dir_down":[-0.433,0.9014],"angle_deg":25.7},"leading_edge":{"points":[[2221,807],[1965,1340]],"angle_deg":25.7,"note":"the leaf and lapel front edge, tip to apex (one straight line); grade is 1 in from it and parallel (CAPR 39-1 5.1.1.1.1.4, 5.2.1.1.1)"},"bottom_edge":{"p1":[2463,1237],"p2":[2193,1237],"mid":[2328,1237],"points":[[2463,1237],[2193,1237]],"angle_deg":0,"note":"the leaf's lower seam (the stitched bottom edge under the grade), outer corner to notch; HORIZONTAL (parallel to the ground). Right/left = wearer's.","dimensions":{"print_cell_in":0.0625,"print_tile_in":[19,14.25],"coat_length_in":29.96,"max_width_in":24.6,"chest_pocket_in":[5,6.4],"chest_flap_in":[5,2.3],"lower_pocket_in":[4.4,6.4],"tape_in":[5,0.9],"print_vector":{"polygons":378,"vertices":8290,"pattern_bytes":39503,"drawn":"straight-edged regions in four flat tones, no raster, no filter"}},"documented":["Desert Tan short or long-sleeved t-shirt worn under the ABU coat, its crew neck shown in the open V (5.1.1.2)","button front, hip length (CAPR 39-1 5.1.1.1); all closures are concealed, so no buttons are drawn","name tape above wearer's right upper pocket, CAP tape above left, cut to pocket width, light silver on dark blue (5.1.1.1.2.1)","badges 1/2 in above the CAP tape (5.1.1.1.2.4)"],"assumed":["px-to-inch scale","pocket sizes/positions (measured off the ABU raster, then scaled)","lower pocket size","tiger-stripe print: our own vector regions (abu-print.js, 2026-11-10), the print's four flat tones as straight-edged polygons: 378 polygons, 8290 vertices, 39503 bytes (the cell outlines it replaces: 1303 loops, 13694 vertices, 39236 bytes), no raster and no filter, one 19 x 14.25 in tile that repeats without a seam (the outlines are traced on a lattice padded by the tile's own wrap). The regions are drawn from the measured design: the tone grid abu-tile.json (abu-trace.js: 304 x 228 cells of 1/16 in read off a 6000 px photograph of original-issue ABU twill, Wikimedia Commons, Qirille, CC BY-SA 4.0, assets/refs/abu, a reference only, never embedded or shipped; cell 14.89 px = 1/16 in, 238.2 px per in, abu-ref-measure.json; the cloth's weave, abu-weave-measure.json, and the Vanguard autocorrelation, abu-scale-check.json, agree), each tone layer blurred 0.65 cell, traced at the level that keeps its area, simplified to 0.5 cell with specks under 5 cells dropped (abu-vector-check.js: tone shares dark / ground / base / tan 0.112 / 0.507 / 0.173 / 0.209 in the grid, 0.112 / 0.505 / 0.176 / 0.207 drawn; 87 percent of cells keep their tone, the rest are edge cells; dark slashes 16.3 per 100 sq in, median 1.31 in long, 0.25 in thick in the grid, 13.7, 1.38, 0.30 drawn); colours matched to the Vanguard shirt photograph (#31332f #51564f #6f746d #9c9888); band length, thickness and stripe angle of the photograph agree with the grid within one cell (abu-trace-report.json); the cell is 1/16 in from the weave pitch of the cloth and the autocorrelation of the Vanguard coat front, NOT from the CAP tape or the pocket size; band-row density along the chest matches the Vanguard shirt (abu-density-check.json)","T-shirt colours in the neck (Desert Tan, estimated; the regulation names the colour, not a value)","all headgear sizes and shapes (patrol cap ~7.8 in wide, baseball cap ~7.6 in wide; head circumference taken as ~22.5 in)"],"fit":{"method":"n/a","score":null},"grade":"garment"}
